company.shortDescription: SCL is a school management system with educational and management modules.
company.description: SCL is a school communication and learning management system with highly secure infrastructure and application complexity such as system activity logs, user activity logs, and two-factor authentication. They also provide an interface that makes any user feel at ease while using the application across any platform. SCL recognizes that each school has its own approach and mindset, which is why everything is customizable with SCL.
